title: [BUG] Auto mode temporarily unavailable on macOS - persists across restarts (v2.1.80)
body:
## Summary

Auto mode shows "temporarily unavailable" persistently. Cannot enter auto mode via `Shift+Tab` cycling or via `defaultMode: "auto"` in settings.json.

## Environment

- **Claude Code version**: 2.1.80
- **Install method**: native (`~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.80`)
- **OS**: macOS Darwin 25.3.0
- **Shell**: zsh
- **Model**: claude-opus-4-6 (1M context)
- **`/doctor` output**: All checks pass (auto-updates enabled, latest version confirmed)

## Behavior

1. Status bar shows `auto mode temporarily unavailable`
2. `Shift+Tab` cycles through Ask → Plan modes only — auto mode is skipped
3. Setting `defaultMode: "auto"` in `~/.claude/settings.json` has no effect
4. Persists across multiple restarts and relaunches

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Launch Claude Code v2.1.80 on macOS
2. Observe status bar: `auto mode temporarily unavailable`
3. Try `Shift+Tab` to cycle modes — auto mode is not reachable

## What I've Tried

- Restarted Claude Code multiple times
- Ran `/doctor` — all checks pass
- Ran `claude update` — already on latest (2.1.80)
- Contacted Anthropic Support — received troubleshooting steps, none resolved the issue

## Related Issues

This appears to be the same issue as #33587.

## Expected Behavior

Auto mode should be available and selectable via `Shift+Tab` or `defaultMode: "auto"` setting.
author: rahulmadan9

top_comments.author: drice
top_comments.body:
This seems to work in 2.1.71:

You can downgrade using:

`curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | sh -s -- 2.1.71`

Then link using ` ln -sf ~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.71 ~/.local/bin/claude`

Edit: You may also want to remove any newer versions in `~/.local/share/claude/versions` and disable auto-update

top_comments.body: I don't want to downgrade though

top_comments.author: yurukusa
top_comments.body:
While waiting for the auto mode fix, you can reduce permission prompts significantly using the `permissions.allow` list in `settings.json`:
```json
// ~/.claude/settings.json
{
  "permissions": {
    "allow": [
      "Bash(git *)",
      "Bash(npm *)",
      "Bash(npx *)",
      "Bash(node *)",
      "Bash(ls *)",
      "Bash(cat *)",
      "Bash(mkdir *)",
      "Bash(cp *)",
      "Bash(mv *)",
      "Read",
      "Write",
      "Edit",
      "Glob",
      "Grep",
      "WebFetch(*)"
    ]
  }
